newsitem.title: USA: Credit card linked to O'Hair said recently used.
newsitem.headline: Credit card linked to O'Hair said recently used.

text.p: A charge account and a credit card linked to missing atheist leader Madalyn Murray O'Hair were used as recently as December and were paid in full, the Houston Chronicle said on Thursday.

O'Hair, her daughter Robin Murray and son Jon Murray have been missing from their Austin, Texas, home since September 1995. But the newspaper said a company that handles collections for American Express confirmed that an average of $1,000 a month had been charged on Robin Murray's American Exress card since August and monthly balances had been paid.
The last bill of $401.78 was paid in December, the Chronicle said. And, it said, a charge account at Lord & Taylor department store was used as recently as last April.

The newspaper said O'Hair's estranged son Bill Murray had asked the Texas Rangers to take over the investigation of his mother's disappearance because he felt Austin Police were not doing a good job. Austin police say they have been hampered by a lack of cooperation from the American Atheists, the organisation that O'Hair headed.
Members of the atheist group say they do not know if O'Hair has left Austin or is dead.
